InteriorModels - interior props for the night jewellery-store scene
Prepared October 14, 2026, revised October 15, 2026. Not yet imported or checked in Unity.

Every file in this folder is CC0 1.0 (Poly Haven), public domain (one painting reproduction,
section 3) or project-owned original work.
No attribution is required for any file; the credits below are a courtesy. Commercial use,
modification and redistribution are allowed. Per-file SHA-256, mirror paths and commits are in
sources.json.

CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

===============================================================================
1. Poly Haven 3D models (CC0 1.0)
===============================================================================
Publisher licence: https://polyhaven.com/license, read from the site source
github.com/Poly-Haven/polyhaven.com @ b1a6aa13afc03ae00860f6ac5fe6d5daf8e95356,
public/locales/en/license.json:
  "All assets (HDRIs, textures and 3D models) on this site are the original work of Poly Haven
   staff, or artists who willingly and directly donate/sell their work to Poly Haven."
  "Our assets are all licensed as CC0 ..."
  "You can use our assets for any purpose, including commercial work."
  "You do not need to give credit or attribution when using them (although it is appreciated)."
  "You can redistribute them, share them around, include them when sharing your own work, or even
   in a product you sell."

polyhaven.com cannot be reached from the build container. The unmodified 2K glTF files (gltf, bin,
2K JPG maps) were taken from the public mirror
  https://github.com/Geadas11/Claude_steam_game @ 8b6aa56f951450b7a05434615bcdda2bd2d1e8fa, assets/3d/models/<id>/ (<id>.gltf, <id>.bin, textures/<id>_*_2k.jpg)
whose tools/fetch_polyhaven.py downloads them unmodified from api.polyhaven.com / dl.polyhaven.org and
whose assets/3d/CREDITS.md lists them as Poly Haven CC0. The repository licence covers its code only.
Verification: 17 models byte-identical (SHA-256) to the dl.polyhaven.org hashes recorded in
  github.com/blue45f/toonstudio @ 526e7bc10963e2cfaaa7278dbb6a86b8ef09acd3 (per-asset SOURCE.json);
metal_office_desk and desk_lamp_arm_01 match the Poly Haven API MD5s recorded in
  github.com/acltabontabon/sev-1 @ cc500f9aeeb6d5e8fbc911ec1c0839b855d6002a;
mid_century_lounge_chair is also byte-identical to github.com/Calinou/godot-benchmark-tool @ bbc93c93.
modern_coffee_table_01, stationery_supplies, hanging_picture_frame_01, standing_picture_frame_01 and
steel_frame_shelves_03 rely on the mirror download script only (no second copy found).

Source page of each: https://polyhaven.com/a/<Poly Haven asset>

Changes made here (all Poly Haven models):
  - converted glTF -> OBJ/MTL (Source~/convert_ph.py): node transforms applied, metres, Y up, welded v/vt/vn
  - base colour -> _Color.jpg, nor_gl -> _Normal.jpg, ARM/roughness (G rough, B metal) -> _MetallicSmoothness.png (R=G=B metal, A = 1 - rough); 2K sources downsized to 1K/512
  - pivot moved (floor: lowest point y = 0, centred in x/z; wall: back at z = 0, centred in x/y; ceiling: top at y = 0)
Model-specific changes:
  - CCTVBulletHousing: fictional spec/regulatory sticker text blanked; decimated 12.5k -> 8.5k triangles; rig not kept (rebuilt October 15 with UV seams and open borders held fixed: the earlier decimation had opened cracks along the seams; every face agrees with its vertex normals)
  - CardboardBox: decimated 17k -> 3k triangles (rebuilt October 15 with UV seams and open borders held fixed: the earlier decimation had opened cracks along the seams, a split corner; every face agrees with its vertex normals)
  - DeskLampArm: decimated 24.1k -> 15k triangles by seam-aware decimation (welded mesh, re-split per UV island, Source~/convert_ph.py decimate_seam_aware; rebuilt October 15: the earlier version had holes in the shade and broken arm rods); every face agrees with its vertex normals
  - FireAlarmCallPoint: raised maker-style wordmark letters removed from the lower name plate (85 small letter meshes) and the matching texture lettering painted out
  - FireExtinguisher: Korean stencil and small text on the base plaque removed from the colour map and (October 15) its embossed relief flattened in the normal map; "UMS" print on the hose removed from the colour and normal maps (October 15); product label (with a maker name) replaced by an original English label; Korean inspection tag with handwritten names replaced by an original English inspection record; decimated 9.9k -> 8k triangles (rebuilt October 15 with UV seams and open borders held fixed: the earlier decimation had opened cracks along the seams; every face agrees with its vertex normals)
  - PendantLampGlobe: clear glass shade written as an MTL constant
  - PhotoFrameDesk: rotated -90 degrees about Y so the photo faces +Z like every other model (October 15)
  - PhotoFrameDesk: photo cropped to its visible area, UVs normalised to 0..1
  - PictureFrameBlack: artwork replaced by an original project print (minimal seascape, PictureFrameBlack_Artwork_Color.jpg); artwork UVs normalised to 0..1
  - PictureFrameGilt: canvas painting cropped to its visible area, UVs normalised to 0..1
  - PictureFrameWhite: renamed from PictureFrameSilver (October 15): Poly Haven describes a distressed white wooden frame
  - PictureFrameWhite: inherited artwork (a painterly-filtered photograph carrying a third-party signature) replaced by a public-domain painting: Paul Cezanne, The Banks of the Marne (c. 1888), cropped to the picture area (PictureFrameWhite_Artwork_Color.jpg, Source~/prep_print.py); artwork UVs normalised to 0..1
  - PottedPlantArrowhead: rebuilt October 15 (70k -> 14,912 triangles): pot shell kept at source detail (5,184 -> 3,792; only the 1,392 faces sealed below the gravel dropped); the 53.9k-triangle dirt layer baked onto a 520-triangle heightfield disc (Gravel material, Source~/bake_gravel.py); leaves decimated 10,692 -> 5,300 with borders preserved and given back faces (10,600 triangles); every face agrees with its vertex normals
  - PottedPlantTall: rebuilt October 15 (176k -> 14,965 triangles): pot shell kept at source detail (5,440 -> 5,184; only 256 faces sealed below the gravel dropped); the 56.9k-triangle pebble layer baked top-down onto a 520-triangle heightfield disc with its own Color/Normal/MetallicSmoothness maps (Gravel material, Source~/bake_gravel.py); leaf blades replaced by alpha-cut cards that keep the original blade vertices and outline (293 leaves, 3,062 triangles incl. back faces; Leaves_Color.png carries the cut-out alpha, Source~/leaf_cards.py); leaf stalks rebuilt as 5-sided tubes (4,550 triangles); trunk decimated with welded seams (7,008 -> 1,649); every face agrees with its vertex normals
  - PottedSucculent: decimated 8.9k -> 5k triangles (rebuilt October 15 with UV seams and open borders held fixed: the earlier decimation had opened cracks along the seams, e.g. a slit down the pot; every face agrees with its vertex normals)
  - StationerySet: pencil print "Haven Penworks" is Poly Haven's own fictional brand and was kept
  - VaseCeramicBottle: decimated 10.3k -> 4.0k triangles (rebuilt October 15 with UV seams and open borders held fixed: the earlier decimation had opened cracks along the seams, holes in the body; every face agrees with its vertex normals)
  - VaseCeramicTall: decimated 11.1k -> 5.4k triangles (rebuilt October 15 with UV seams and open borders held fixed: the earlier decimation had opened cracks along the seams, holes at the base; every face agrees with its vertex normals)
  - WallClock: maker-style wordmark on the dial painted out (patch from the clean dial)
Texture edits are reproducible with Source~/edit_textures.py; the replacement label, tag and the
PictureFrameBlack print are original project artwork (fictional text only, no real brand, maker,
person or signature). The PictureFrameWhite picture is a public-domain painting (section 3).
Gravel maps (PottedPlant*_Gravel_*) and the alpha mask in PottedPlantTall_Leaves_Color.png are baked
from the CC0 source meshes and maps (Source~/bake_gravel.py, Source~/leaf_cards.py) and stay CC0.

Voluntary credit line: "3D models by Kuutti Siitonen, Yann Kervran, Vibrant Nordic, Caspian Fortune,
Amin, Rico Cilliers, Rob Tuytel, James Ray Cock, PierreB3D, Mateusz Sadek, UM JOORIN, Slinc,
Ulan Cabanilla, Garrison Gager and Rahul Chaudhary (polyhaven.com, CC0)."

===============================================================================
2. Project-owned original work
===============================================================================
Made for this repository on October 14, 2026 with Python (numpy, Pillow, trimesh): procedural geometry
and procedural textures only, no third-party models, photos or textures. Project-owned; the project may
use, change and redistribute them without restriction (treat them like CC0).

  Models: CCTVDome, CeilingDiffuser, CoffeeMachine, ComputerMonitor, DVRRecorder, DeskPhone, DoorLeverHandle, DoorPullHandle, ExitSign,
          FilingCabinet, FilingCabinetOpen, Keyboard, LEDPanel, LeverArchFiles, MiniFridge, Mouse, OfficeChair, RecessedDownlight,
          Rug, SecurityMonitor, SmokeDetector, SnakePlant, TrackLight, WallVent, WaterCooler
  Textures: Shared_* (tiling plastic, fabric, mesh weave, brushed steel, powder coat), Monitor_Screen_*,
          Keyboard_Color, Mouse_Color, DeskPhone_Face_*, FilingCabinet_Labels, LeverArchFiles_Color,
          DVRRecorder_Front_Color, WaterCooler_Vent_Color, CoffeeMachine_Panel_*, ExitSign_Face, Rug_*,
          SnakePlant_*, PictureFrameBlack_Artwork_Color (original seascape print)
  Source~/*.py: generator and conversion scripts (Unity ignores folders ending in "~").
  Source~/meshkit.py is adapted from Prototype/ThirdParty/ForensicModels/Source~/meshkit.py (project-owned).

Printed text on screens, labels, keycaps, tags and signs was rasterised with DejaVu Sans / Sans Mono
(Bitstream Vera licence) and GNU FreeSans Oblique (GPL with font exception); only glyph images are
used, no font file is shipped. All names, times, extensions and labels are fictional; the exit-sign
pictogram is an original drawing in the conventional green running-figure style. No real brand, logo,
trademark or identifiable person is depicted.

===============================================================================
3. Public-domain painting: PictureFrameWhite_Artwork_Color.jpg
===============================================================================
Painting : Paul Cezanne (1839-1906), "The Banks of the Marne (Villa on the Bank of a River)",
           c. 1888, oil on canvas, State Hermitage Museum, St Petersburg.
Scan     : https://github.com/pmilovanov/hermitage-art @ b8ead49c010eac0c8366bafc4ffaaf1f1a447805
           (2021-01-28), file "Cezanne,_Paul_-_The_Banks_of_the_Marne_(Villa_on_the_Bank_of_a_River).jpg",
           SHA-256 d0b9bc6f99f7c9c9dbc908546e7aa74bf8f6b4cba5c494c1b9ed59715e6d444d, 8,216,755 bytes.
Status   : public domain. The painter died in 1906, so the work is out of copyright everywhere
           (life + 100 years at most); a faithful photographic reproduction of a two-dimensional
           work carries no new copyright (US: Bridgeman v. Corel, 1999; EU: Directive 2019/790,
           article 14). The repository is additionally dedicated to CC0 1.0 (its LICENSE file).
           Public Domain Mark: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/
Changes  : cropped to the frame's 1.706:1 picture area (40 px trimmed left and right, rows
           300-2795 of 3440 kept), resized to 1280 x 750, light unsharp mask (Source~/prep_print.py).
No signature, person, brand or text is visible in the crop. Attribution not required; courtesy
credit: "Paul Cezanne, The Banks of the Marne, c. 1888 (public domain, State Hermitage Museum)".
The same repository supplies the WallGraphics paintings; this painting is not used there.
